thread:
mira: quick heads-up — noticed a perf regression on the embeddings/reranker endpoint after the kernel-selection patch rolled last night. p50 for small batches jumped from ~18ms -> ~42ms at GPU pool A. anyone else seeing this? :thinking_face:

alex_g: saw the alert, thanks. Is this for non-chat endpoints only (embeddings/rerank) or chat too?

mira: non-chat only — embedding + pairwise rerank traffic. profiling shows a lot more kernel-switch churn and worker wakeups during batch formation.

dan_r: interesting. could be the new kernel-selector trying to pick quant-friendly kernels per-request which adds scheduling overhead. we added a sync step in the selector last deploy.

sasha: do we have flamegraphs or trace snippets? I ran a quick top-down perf and saw extra time in `select_kernel()` and `prepare_attn_buffers()` even though rerank inputs are short (avg 64 tokens).

mira: yup attached snippet from perf-runner (truncated):
```
p50: 42ms (was 18ms)
p95: 210ms (was 120ms)
hot spots:
 - select_kernel() +10ms
 - worker_queue_spin +8ms
 - prep_tensor_copies +6ms
```

alex_g: thanks. suspect interaction between continuous-batcher heuristics and kernel selection. we currently re-evaluate kernel per-request before adding to a batch which forces per-request work on the critical path.

jasmin: we also bumped `min_batch=8` in the pool config last week to improve throughput — that could increase wait amplification for small requests.

dan_r: for embeddings/rerank we should switch to kernel preselection that happens off the critical path: preselect based on short fingerprint (model id + seq_len bucket) and reuse for N sec. reduces churn.

sasha: +1. another low-risk experiment: change queue policy from FIFO to a max-token-budget window where we form batches until sum(tokens) >= T or max_wait hit. That lets many tiny requests be bundled quickly.

mira: noted. proposed experiment matrix: 1) enable kernel preselection cache (TTL 5s) 2) token-budget batching with T={256,512,1024} 3) EDF (earliest-deadline-first) priority for low-latency routes 4) revert min_batch to 4 for rerank pool.

alex_g: put that in a canary. we should also instrument per-batch kernel-selection time and cache hit ratio. add metrics: `kernel_select_ms`, `kernel_cache_hit`, `batch_token_sum`, `batch_wait_ms`.

perf-bot: scheduled benchmark run: bench/emb-rerank/2026-03-17-09:30 UTC (canary). config: kernel_cache_ttl=5s, batching=T=512, policy=token_budget, min_batch=4.

jasmin: small data note — reranker client can send N pairwise items which expands token count drastically. make sure client-side max_items is honored in queue accounting.

dan_r: good call. queue accounting should be based on token-equivalent of full work per request (pairs * avg_seq_len). otherwise budgets are misleading.

mira: after the canary we saw p50 -> 20ms, p95 115ms. kernel_cache_hit ~81%. batch_token_sum median 480. overall cost slightly higher per-token but latency restored.

alex_g: nice. any regressions in chat endpoints?

mira: no, chat unchanged. looks isolated to non-chat reranker workloads because of earlier min_batch change + selector sync.

sasha: one more optimization: fast-path kernel selection for seq_len <= 96 choose `k_small` kernel w/ no validation; that avoids checks. add a guarded fallback for correctness.

dan_r: careful — make sure kernel fallback doesn't do expensive tensor layout conversions on the critical path. offload conversions to async worker if possible.

mira: agreed. next steps: 1) roll token-budget batching + kernel cache pool-wide for rerank pool 2) add kernel selection metrics 3) implement fast-path kernel for short seq lengths and async conversion 4) monitor cost & p95 for a week before wider rollout.

alex_g: I'll open a PR for kernel cache + metrics. tag: @sasha @dan_r for review. thanks all :rocket:

jasmin: I'll update routing policy to ensure rerank traffic hits rerank pool (so experiment isolates).

perf-bot: canary finished: results uploaded to bench dashboard -> link: https://bench.internal/emb-rerank/1767004321 (perf graphs, traces).

mira: excellent. if numbers hold we'll promote to dedicated pool in 24h. :eyes:

alex_g: quick note for release notes: call out the new `batching.policy=token_budget` and `kernel_cache_ttl` flags, and recommend lower `min_batch` for low-latency rerank use cases.

sasha: thanks — I'll draft the ops runbook for debugging batch formation and kernel cache misses.

mira: closing the loop: regression explained by kernel selector sync + min_batch bump — mitigated by token-budget batching + kernel cache. we'll keep monitoring. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
